definition: Automated Insights (AI) is an American-based technology company specializing in natural language generation (NLG) software that turns big data into readable narratives.
details: Their flagship product, Wordsmith, transforms structured data into written narratives, allowing businesses to automate the creation of reports, articles, and other content. This technology is used by organizations like the Associated Press to automate the generation of news stories from financial data. Automated Insights produced 300 million pieces of content in 2013, which Mashable reported was greater than the output of all major media companies combined. In 2014, the company's software generated one billion stories. In 2016, Automated Insights produced over 1.5 billion pieces of content.

explainer.lead: Automated Insights is an American technology company that builds natural language generation software. Its flagship product, Wordsmith, turns structured data into readable reports and stories, helping organizations produce large volumes of routine written content.

tiers.eli5: Imagine a computer that can look at a table of numbers and explain what happened in ordinary sentences. Automated Insights makes software that does this, so a business does not have to write every similar report by hand. Its software has also helped turn financial data into news stories.
tiers.practitioner: Wordsmith is applied to structured data to automate recurring narratives such as business reports and data-driven articles. The practical setting is high-volume content generation, with the Associated Press using the technology to produce news stories from financial data.
tiers.paperLevel: Automated Insights develops natural language generation systems, expressible as NLG: structured data D -> readable narrative N. Its Wordsmith product applies this mapping to reports, articles, and other content; the company reported outputs of 300 million pieces in 2013, one billion stories in 2014, and over 1.5 billion pieces in 2016.

explainer.example: The Associated Press supplies financial data, and the technology converts that structured information into a readable news story instead of requiring each story to be written manually.
